ABOUT US

Pliant is a modular B2B payments platform that combines commercial card issuing, payment accounts, FX, and spend management in one system — adapting to existing setups rather than requiring customers to replace them.

Businesses across industries such as travel, e-commerce, and insurance use Pliant to manage complex payment workflows with cards, backed by credit lines Pliant underwrites itself.

Fintechs and software platforms embed Pliant's payment infrastructure into their own products, from API-based Cards-as-a-Service to fully white-label solutions. Banks use Pliant's Card & Spend OS, the customer-facing interface, on their own infrastructure to run card programs.

Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Berlin, Pliant serves 5,000+ businesses and 40+ partners across Europe and the United States. A principal member of Visa and Mastercard, Pliant issues commercial cards in 13 currencies across 32 countries — under its own European e-money license and with licensed partners in the UK and US.

Learn more at www.getpliant.com

ABOUT THE ROLE

🚀 Join us as our next Senior Product Designer, Design systems and help build the world's best corporate credit card experience.

This role blends hands-on product design with deep design-system ownership. You'll split your time between shipping product features embedded in a team and owning the evolution of our design system — both are core to the role, not one squeezed in around the other. On the design-system side, you'll maintain and improve it and lead its evolution for AI-assisted workflows.

You'll bring structure and craft to our product's user experience, work across our web and mobile applications, and become the owner of the system that keeps everything consistent as we scale across product teams, internal tools, and data dashboards.

You'll collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to shape our roadmap and deliver new features, all while raising the quality and consistency bar through a world-class design system.

Pliant has design in its DNA – our design team reports directly to one of the founders. Although our team is small, we thrive on finding the best solutions to design problems, and we hire people who have a keen interest in shaping our expansion and being part of the journey for years to come.

If you thrive in fast-moving environments, are a proactive designer, love challenging how design work gets done, and want to shape the future of product design with AI while making a direct impact, this role is for you.

Although we have Berlin listed as the main location, we value flexibility to work remotely or hybrid from one of our hubs (Berlin, London, Vienna, Helsinki). If not based in Berlin, you ideally must be able to join team meetings throughout the year and be within a +/- 3 hour of GMT timezone.

❗ Please attach your CV and portfolio with your application.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Own the design system domain: Be the accountable owner of our design system – components, tokens, patterns, and documentation – keeping it consistent and high-quality as the team and product grow.

Design product day to day: Embed in a product team and design end-to-end features across our web platform, mobile app, internal tools, and dashboards – from user flows and wireframes to high-fidelity UI and prototypes.

Take the design system into the AI era: Restructure our tokens, components, and documentation so AI agents can read and use them, enabling prototypes that map one-to-one to our code. Close the gap between what we design and what we ship.

Partner closely with engineering: Keep the design system and codebase in sync – aligning naming, tokens, and component APIs so design and code stay 1:1.

Raise the consistency bar: Define and champion standards, review component usage across flows, and help other designers move faster within a shared system.

Collaborate cross-functionally: Work with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders from discovery through delivery, ensuring smooth implementation of your designs.

Wear multiple hats when needed: We're a lean team, and everyone steps up to support different design needs. You're not afraid to jump into projects outside your main scope to drive company success.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

5+ years of experience in product design, UX/UI, or digital design (agency or in-house), with at least 1 year in a senior or lead role.

Deep, demonstrable expertise in design systems – you've built, scaled, and governed a design system, not just consumed one.

Strong command of component architecture, design tokens, theming/modes, and documentation, with a systematic approach to naming and structure.

Advanced Figma skills – variables, modes, component properties, and auto-layout. You build systems, not just screens.

A solid understanding of how design systems map to front-end code (tokens, component structure), and comfort collaborating closely with engineers to keep design and code 1:1. Curiosity about how AI/agent-assisted design workflows are evolving is a strong plus.

A proven ability to design end-to-end product experiences across web, mobile apps, internal tools, and dashboards.

Excellent craft in interaction and visual design – you care deeply about clarity, hierarchy, and making complex workflows feel simple.

A proactive, highly organized way of working – you set the standard for structure and thrive with autonomy while collaborating closely with PMs and engineers.

Strong communication skills – you're comfortable presenting your work, explaining your rationale, and inviting feedback.

Experience working in agile, fast-paced environments, iterating quickly based on feedback and data.

Experience in fintech or B2B SaaS is nice-to-have, but curiosity and adaptability matter more.

Description

Director Product Design 

Europe / Remote 
Reports to the Chief Strategy and Product Officer 

About Velsera 

Velsera builds software that turns complex biological data into research insight and clinical answers. Our platforms work across multi-omic and multi-modal data: genomics alongside proteomics, transcriptomics and other omics, together with imaging, clinical and real-world data, at the scale of some of the world's largest biomedical programs. Pharmaceutical companies, biotechs, public research initiatives and diagnostic laboratories use our products to advance precision medicine. 

We run like a scale-up: small teams with real authority, fast decisions, and AI woven into how we work day to day. We measure ourselves on impact for our customers and, ultimately, for patients. 

The opportunity 

You'd be joining as the design authority for our Seven Bridges Platform and the leader of design at Velsera, just as we rebuild how we design, validate and ship. You report directly to the Chief Strategy and Product Officer, and decisions that take quarters elsewhere happen here in days. Our product managers have already started turning ideas into working, on-brand prototypes with AI and put them in front of customers within weeks. The design foundations that make that speed safe are yours to build and own: design tokens, a component library, and the patterns everyone works with. 

That's the shape of your influence here. Product managers prototype with the system you build, you review what customers will see, and once a concept is validated, production design belongs to you: journeys that hold up across every state, edge case and installation. This is a product bioinformaticians, scientists and clinicians rely on every day, and you set its bar. 

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll manage our product designer working on the clinical side of our portfolio, you'll build the design function as it grows, and you'll keep doing the craft yourself. There's no large design team to inherit; there's one to create. 

The product is changing as fast as the craft is. Our users increasingly work alongside AI in research and diagnostic workflows, with dense, high-stakes data from many sources. Someone needs to rethink the journeys, trust models and information design of software like ours for that reality. That is a key remit of this job. 

This role won't suit everyone. If you're looking for a mature design organization with settled processes, you won't find that here yet. If you want to build the system a whole company designs with, lead design for products with real clinical stakes, and do it at scale-up speed, we should talk. 

What will you do?

Own the user journeys, flows and interaction design of the Seven Bridges Platform: partner with product managers on problems, outcomes and scope, then own how the experience actually works, from structure and states down to the number of clicks. 
Build our design system from the ground up: design tokens, a component library aligned with our front-end code, and the standards that bring our product surfaces together under one visual language. The whole organization will prototype with what you build. 
Keep rapid prototyping fast and safe: maintain the foundations PMs build with, review prototype quality before customers see it, and take validated prototypes through to production-ready design. 
Manage our product designer on the clinical side: set goals, develop their craft, give honest feedback, and answer for the quality of design across both businesses. As the team grows, you'll hire and shape it. 
Design for AI in the product itself: assistant and copilot experiences, AI-generated results that scientists and clinicians can trust and verify, and workflows where automation and human judgment work together. 
Work closely with front-end engineers so the design system lives in code, not only in Figma. 
Use product analytics to see where users struggle, make experience debt visible, and give product leadership a clear case for what to fix first. 
Bring design judgment into strategy conversations at the leadership level. 

Your first few months 

The first version of the design system is live, with tokens and core components in Figma and in code, and product managers are actually prototyping on top of it. You've reviewed working prototypes before they went in front of real customers, and what we shipped is better for it. You and the designer you manage have a real working rhythm, with clear goals and honest feedback, and it shows in the work. And your map of our experience debt is on the leadership table with a clear case for what to fix first. 

Requirements

What do you bring to the table?

You've spent seven or more years in product design, with senior ownership of user journeys on complex, data-heavy or scientific software. 

You've built or led at least one design system that engineering genuinely adopted, and you know what it takes to keep one alive. 
You've managed designers formally, not just mentored them, and the people you've managed got better and would work for you again. 
You're comfortable having your biggest impact through a system other people build with, not only through screens you designed yourself. 
You've chosen fast, ambiguous environments before, and you're looking for another one. 
You already use AI tools to design, prototype and produce working software (we work with Claude, from design exploration through design-to-code), and you have well-formed opinions about where these tools help and where they mislead. 
You've designed AI-powered product experiences, or you have a clear point of view on trust, transparency and human oversight in AI interfaces. 
You're an expert in Figma, including variables and design-to-code workflows such as Code Connect.

About Us

Rho is the modern banking platform built for the AI era. Startups and growth-stage companies can open accounts in minutes, issue cards, manage expenses, pay bills, and close the books – all in one connected platform backed by real human support.

About the Role

As a Staff Product Designer at Rho, you will champion the craft of design to deliver experiences that are not only functional but thoughtfully refined. You’ll take end-to-end ownership of complex product areas, consistently holding a high bar for usability, visual polish, and quality of execution. With an instinct for user behavior and a relentless attention to detail, you'll bring clarity to ambiguous problems and advocate for the end user in every decision. Working closely with product and engineering partners, you'll lead the creation of intuitive solutions that feel seamless, scalable, and rooted in empathy—ensuring every design moment reflects Rho's commitment to frictionless finance.

Responsibilities

Lead design efforts for end-to-end product features across multiple surfaces

Own complex design problems with minimal oversight—from exploration to polished execution.

Collaborate deeply with product managers and engineers to shape scope, identify dependencies, and optimize user flows.

Define interaction patterns and craft scalable, accessible solutions informed by data and user research.

Develop prototypes to test concepts, gather feedback, and drive alignment.

Uphold and evolve design quality by considering both micro-interactions and holistic experience.

Communicate ideas clearly across design critiques, cross-functional meetings, and stakeholder reviews.

Contribute to design system enhancements and advocate for design quality across teams.

Qualifications

6+ years of experience designing digital products, with a portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership. Fintech experience preferred but is not necessary

Skilled in prototyping, UI/UX, interaction design, and visual polish.

Proven ability to work autonomously, plan work, and push projects forward independently.

Comfortable designing for ambiguity, resolving complex workflows, and simplifying edge cases.

Strong collaboration and communication skills; experience presenting to executives and external partners.

Familiar with applying qualitative and quantitative research methods to inform decisions.

Experience working with or contributing to a design system.

Adaptable, pragmatic, and empathetic—able to thrive in fast-changing, collaborative environments

Our people are our most valuable asset. The salary range for this role is $195,000-$260,000. Base salary may vary depending on relevant experience, skills, and business needs. In addition to base pay, Rho offers equity, healthcare benefits, and paid time off.

Diversity is a core value at Rho. We’re passionate about building and sustaining an inclusive and equitable environment for all those involved with our mission, including employees, contractors, candidates, customers, and vendors. We believe every member of the Rho community enriches our ability to provide a broad range of ways to understand and engage with the market, identify problems, and drive solutions that align with our mission. We welcome all qualified applications and support each of our Rho’ers with ongoing professional growth opportunities.

Description

Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system.

We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.

We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers.

We're hiring a Product Designer to shape the products and experiences that make energy abundant. This is an early design hire, so you'll help define the entire roadmap, working directly with our CEO (ex-Revolut) and across engineering, trading and operations. Our design team includes people from Pentagram, Revolut and Arrival. Design leads product here, not PMs.

Responsibilities
Consumer products: mobile and web apps that reward users for controlling their usage, balancing grid demand and upgrading their home with solar, batteries and EVs
Physical and digital experiences: home energy upgrades, hardware products and home IoT device controls
Brand expression and identity: define Fuse's visual language across web, mobile, motion and physical products
High-stakes interfaces: internal tools and platforms that manage gigawatts of renewable energy, thousands of installations and millions of customers, built from scratch
As we scale, design grid management systems, reward mechanisms and products that do not exist yet
Requirements
5+ years of experience designing consumer-facing digital products
Strong craft across typography, colour, composition and UX
A track record of working end-to-end from initial vision and discovery through to design execution
You translate complex systems into interfaces with a logical, modular and re-usable structure that just makes sense
Excellent written communication skills
Figma expert (non-negotiable)
Bonus: motion graphics, 3D (C4D, Spline), copywriting or code
Benefits
Competitive salary and eligibility for equity
Biannual bonus scheme
Fully expensed tech to match your needs
Private health insurance
Breakfast and dinner allowance for office-based employees

As we hire globally, benefits vary by location.
